assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lists all four required sections as PRESENT: 'Issue Description (PRESENT)' with full content (lines 36-41), 'Steps to Reproduce (PRESENT)' with numbered steps (lines 44-49), 'Expected Result (PRESENT)' with expected output (lines 53-56), 'Actual Result (PRESENT)' with actual behavior (lines 59-61). The bug-template-mock.md specifies heading formats ### **Issue Description**, ### **Steps to Reproduce**, ### **Expected Result**, ### **Actual Result**, and all four were successfully extracted.

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 16-18: 'Issue type on ACME-500: Bug (ID: 10020)' / 'Bug Configuration Bug issue type ID: 10020' / '**Result**: Match confirmed -- issue is a Bug.'

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md line 22-23: 'The heading text is extracted using `line[3:]`, which takes everything after the `## ` prefix -- including any trailing whitespace.' Line 35: 'The behavior diverges from expected at the heading extraction step (`line[3:]`), where trailing whitespace is preserved.' Line 70: 'section_name = line[3:]  # BUG: does not strip trailing whitespace'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md -- What: 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which preserves trailing whitespace from the heading line' (line 13-14). Where: 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- Convention conformance analysis section: heading extraction at `line[3:]` does not strip trailing whitespace' (lines 21-23). How to verify: 'Create a test fixture `CONVENTIONS.md` that includes a heading with trailing whitespace... Assert that the convention is correctly matched and included in the generated task\'s Implementation Notes' (lines 41-46).

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Acceptance Criteria section: First item (line 75) is '- [ ] A reproducer test demonstrates the bug: a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on a heading causes the convention to be silently dropped (fails before fix, passes after fix)'. This precedes the fix criteria on lines 76-78 ('Heading extraction... strips trailing whitespace', 'Conventions... are correctly matched', 'No regression').

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Test Requirements section: First item (line 81) is 'Reproducer test: create a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on at least one heading (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  `), run convention conformance analysis, and assert the convention is matched and included in the output. The test should assert the output contains `Per CONVENTIONS.md Migration Patterns:` (or equivalent convention reference). Before the fix this test must fail; after the fix it must pass.' The assertion guidance ('assert the output contains `Per CONVENTIONS.md Migration Patterns:`') is derived from the Steps to Reproduce expected output.

assertion_results.text: Task description includes a Bug Context section with Bug key (ACME-500), Steps to Reproduce, Expected/Actual Result, and Root Cause summary (Step 5 Bug Context extension)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 85-91: '## Bug Context' section contains: Bug key '[ACME-500](https://mock-jira.example.com/browse/ACME-500)', Steps to Reproduce ('Create a CONVENTIONS.md with trailing whitespace on a heading...'), Expected Result ('The generated task\'s Implementation Notes should include: `Per CONVENTIONS.md Migration Patterns:...`'), Actual Result ('The generated task\'s Implementation Notes do NOT reference the Migration Patterns convention...'), Root Cause ('The heading extraction uses `line[3:]` which preserves trailing whitespace...').
